# EventSphere

> EventSphere is a modern multi-tenant event ticketing and management platform in West Africa, featuring instant Paystack checkout (Mobile Money & Card), downloadable receipts with scannable QR passes, quick WhatsApp ticket sharing, and real-time organizer revenue settlement.

## Core Capabilities
- **Event Discovery & Ticketing**: Attendees can browse concerts, tech conferences, cultural festivals, and executive summits, select tiers, and purchase verified passes.
- **Paystack Payment Rails**: Direct integration supporting MTN Mobile Money, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo, Visa, Mastercard, Verve, USSD, and Bank Transfers.
- **Digital Passes & Verified Receipts**: Scannable QR passes generated on registration, complete with attendee contact details (full name, phone, email) and verifiable receipts.
- **WhatsApp Quick Share**: 1-click sharing of ticket codes, receipts, and event schedules directly into WhatsApp.
- **Gate Check-In Scanner**: In-browser camera scanning to validate attendee QR tokens in under 1 second and prevent duplicate admissions.
- **Organizer Revenue & Payouts**: Automated calculation of net earnings with transparent commission rates and bank/mobile money withdrawal transfers.
